llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed single-image scanning/enhancement integration, with privacy and scoping notes users should read before uploading files.

dimensions.detail: Uploading images to scan-business.quark.cn is purpose-aligned and explicitly disclosed, but users should treat submitted documents and photos as third-party processed data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer or bundled executable was present in the artifact; setup is limited to configuring SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY through skill-platform config or an environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broader than the stated image-scanning purpose because it mentions generic file processing, document conversion, format conversion, and content extraction, but the detailed examples and limits consistently describe single static image processing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only persistence described is storing the API key in skill configuration if the user chooses the CLI config path; no background workers, autorun behavior, privilege escalation, or broad indexing is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is image/document scan enhancement using Quark Scan API features such as sharpening, shadow removal, handwriting removal, watermark removal, and line-art extraction; the requested read/exec capability fits the documented command-line workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected images or document photos to Quark's scan service for processing. Use it for explicit image scan/enhancement tasks, avoid sensitive documents unless appropriate, and prefer temporary environment-variable credentials if you do not want the API key stored in skill configuration.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The artifact does contain an overbroad trigger statement for generic file/document tasks, so the finding is valid as a routing caution; it does not by itself show hidden execution, deception, or purpose-mismatched data handling because the skill otherwise discloses single-image limits and external image upload.
